'''2026 Retro Worlds Will Tarbox LS Mind What You Have Learned''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Will Tarbox]] at the [[2026 Retro World Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Will Tarbox]]
* '''Event:''' [[2026 Retro World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
